Archive policy

Your photos stay yours.

FilmDesk has no server. Your logbook lives on your phone, and backup goes to a folder in your own Google Drive that you control.

FAQ

Why does FilmDesk ask for photo access?

To check whether the original of each scan is still on your phone, so the app can warn you before you lose it and pick the right file to back up.

When do my photos go to Google Drive?

When you're on Wi‑Fi and the battery isn't low. A small cloud mark on each photo shows whether it's uploaded or waiting.

I got a new phone. How do I get my logbook back?

Install FilmDesk, answer "Used FilmDesk before?" and restore from your Drive. Pro comes back with the same Google account.

Is there a subscription?

No. Pro is a single purchase. Even without Pro, everything you made stays viewable and editable.
